name: Reviews Carousel
author: Nancy

sections.description:
Reviews Carousel is a free and powerful plugin that lets you create and showcase customer reviews in a dynamic carousel format. It provides a dedicated custom post type for reviews, allowing both admins and users to submit reviews with text, images, or videos for a richer experience.

✅ Key Features:

Create and manage reviews with text, images, and videos

Allow users to submit reviews in image or video format

Display reviews in a responsive carousel layout

Simple shortcode integration for easy placement anywhere on your site

Works seamlessly with all WordPress themes

📌 Usage:

Perfect for businesses, product showcases, testimonials, and more! 🚀

This plugin is perfect for businesses, product showcases, testimonials, and more! 🚀
[revica]
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Type Reviews Carousel in the search box.
  3. Click Install Now to install the plugin.
  4. After installation, click Activate to start using the Reviews Carousel.
  5. Go to Reviews from the Dashboard menu.
  6. Add your review data.
  7. Use the shortcode [revica] to display the review carousel anywhere on your site.
